walk_bounds.note: Outer bounds only; walkability comes from navigation polygons.

top_layout_annotation: Labels and route over actual rendered top view; raw screenshot remains in output.
limits: Programmatic walk and gesture regression, no Android input claim.
No physical phone performance, map-entry integration, release, or whitebox approval is claimed.

reference_comparison.scope: Colour comparison only; generated concept geometry is not the measurement authority.

palette.intent: Warm limestone museum, light sand paths, yellow-green garden terraces and blue-green bay; matte vertex color.
palette.limits: Art palette under existing scene lighting; original concept supplies colour direction, written brief supplies physical dimensions.

alc_ground_fields.png.R: periodic grass macro field + extra perimeter noise (independent seed4241107), repeats24m/38.832m
alc_ground_fields.png.B: reserved mineral micrograin, unused by v1 shader

alc_ground_surfaces.png.B: wood grain along local X, repeat3x1m

constraints: No changes to host GLB, UV, layout, navigation, lighting, cameras, sea or rocks
Replace material_override on only the listed four MeshInstance3D objects; surface override alone is hidden by existing host material_override
Preserve imported linear COLOR_0, bind both packed textures as data (no source_color hint)
World-space grass/paving; dock-local grain. No triplanar cliff detail, no normal/depth/alpha or extra passes
If host vertex palette changes, update classification uniforms or leave optional material off
Dock selector assumes original top face local Y=0; reused mesh can translate/rotate without losing grain alignment

garden/garden_dark/garden_light remain original COLOR_0 selection keys; only grass_deep_color/grass_base_color/grass_sun_color control displayed grass hue. Keep source palette unchanged, including merged ruin/terrain surface.
ground_materials.acceptance: 不知火舞确定套用；v1.1只增强草坡，石板与木纹冻结于91c563b16
ground_materials.selection_palette_note: palette_hex remains original host COLOR_0 selection keys; displayed grass colours are the three grass_*_color parameters.

hud_clearance.note: Review masks only, no runtime HUD added. Check default 43deg/6.72m follow along dock-to-museum route; re-evaluate if integration changes UI or asset bounds.
